🟡 **Version guard counts SELECT aliases** For `SELECT i.time version` in a materialized CTE, `excludeOutputAliases` leaves the `version` alias visible. [referenceEndsOperand](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L305-L321 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:305-321") treats `time` as a keyword even after a dot. The generator accepts an update that never references the version column.
Learn more The version guard scans a statement for the configured column name. [postgresReferencesColumn](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L22-L40 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:22-40") relies on the exclusion pass to distinguish column references from name declarations. For bare output aliases, [excludeOutputAlias](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L295-L303 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:295-303") checks whether the preceding token can end an expression. [referenceEndsOperand](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L305-L321 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:305-321") rejects the word `time` without checking whether it is the final component of a qualified identifier. **Example:** With `items.time` as an ordinary column and `items.version` as the configured version column, `WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT i.time version FROM items AS i) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'` generates even though `version` is only an output label. **Recommended fix:** Recognize qualified identifier tails as expression operands before checking bare keyword spellings. Add a refusal case alongside [TestPostgresCTEProjectionRoles](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_projection_test.lgo#L9-L29 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_projection_test.lgo:9-29") and retain the existing genuine-operand controls.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🟡 **Version guard counts table aliases** In a materialized CTE, `excludeReferenceDeclarations` leaves the bare table alias in `FROM items version` visible. The generator accepts a write that never references the version column.
Learn more The declaration pass skips the bodies of recognized materialized CTE headers so genuine column references remain visible. The scan then accepts any matching name that survives the exclusions in [postgresReferencesColumn](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L22-L40 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:22-40"). [excludeWriteHeaders](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo#L193-L205 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference.lgo:193-205") covers write targets, not table declarations in a SELECT. A SELECT table alias introduced without `AS` therefore remains visible even though it declares a relation name. **Example:** With the standard `items` fixture, `WITH seed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT id FROM items version) UPDATE items SET name = 'changed'` passes the guard. `version` names the relation alias, not the column. **Recommended fix:** Exclude implicit relation alias declarations in SELECT table expressions without masking expression operands. Add a refusal case to [TestPostgresVersionCTEs](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference_test.lgo#L53-L73 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference_test.lgo:53-73") and keep its genuine column-reference controls.
--- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Overlong PostgreSQL specification requirements** The identifier, excluded-name, and CTE suffix requirements each contain a sentence above the repository’s 20-word limit. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*

🔍 **Missing sqlc coverage for CTEs and catalog casing** `readSQLcLiteralInputs` adds reference-role cases, but no materialized CTE or mixed-case catalog case. [TestPostgresVersionCatalogResolution](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_catalog_test.lgo#L20-L40 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_catalog_test.lgo:20-40") edits the catalog in memory, and [TestPostgresVersionCTEs](https://github.com/gosuda/spira/blob/f3a47a04f1defe427494124507ec621118525265/cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference_test.lgo#L53-L73 "cmd/sqlc-gen-spira/version_reference_test.lgo:53-73") calls the plugin directly. Neither checks the actual sqlc handoff. --- *Was this helpful? React with 👍 or 👎 to provide feedback.*
